content: Department Phone: 845-782-3242. Department Fax: 855-592-1423. Medical Records & Proof of Address Letters: medicalrecords@aizerhealth.org (Contact: Arwa 'Amy' Adel at Ext. 2100). Forest Rd Location (49 Forest Rd, 2nd Floor): Dr. Neil Shinder (Tue-Fri) and all Specialty Providers (Cardiology, Dermatology, Pain Management, Sleep, Nutrition). Bakertown Location (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor): Adam Tilson PA, Naftali Minzer PA, Myer Gurkov PA, and Dr. Neil Shinder (Sundays only).

Standard adult medicine visit duration is 15 minutes. Mandatory 30-minute duration is required for patients aged 65 or older regardless of visit reason. Patients with a 'chronic patient' billing alert must be scheduled for 30 minutes. Patients with a documented 'long problem list' must be scheduled for 30 minutes.

Role: Physician Assistant (PA) in Adult Medicine. Location & Schedule: Bakertown (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor), Monday through Thursday (Fridays reserved for administrative duties). Most popular provider, often booked several months in advance. Age Restriction: Does NOT see new patients over 60-65 years old due to panel capacity and follow-up constraints; this applies even if the patient is established with the clinic but seeing Adam Tilson for the first time. Default provider on nurse schedule for Flu Shots (Mon-Thu 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM).

Role: Physician Assistant (PA) in Adult Medicine. Location & Schedule: Bakertown (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor), Monday through Thursday plus alternating Sundays and Fridays. Commercial Driver's License (CDL) Exams: Limited to two per day (1 morning, 1 afternoon), always 30 minutes. Lap Band Adjustments: Authorized for bariatric patients (maximum 2 per day).

Role: Physician Assistant (PA) in Adult Medicine. Location & Schedule: Bakertown (48 Bakertown Rd, 3rd Floor), Monday through Thursday plus alternating Sundays and Fridays. Handles high volume of chronic patients including Hamaspik and RAYIM. Saturday night shifts are for urgent care only and are NOT pre-booked. Strictly does NOT perform CDL exams or lap band adjustments.

Role: Sole Primary Medical Doctor (MD) for all Internal Medicine patients. Schedule & Locations: Forest Rd (2nd Floor) Tuesday through Friday; Bakertown (3rd Floor) Sundays only. All Physical Exam (PE) and New Patient appointments with Dr. Shinder must be 30 minutes regardless of patient age. Tuesdays are dedicated exclusively to his Sleep Medicine specialty practice (requires referral).

Specialty: Dermatology at Forest Rd (2nd Floor), every Thursday and alternate Mondays. Duration: 10 minutes for Office Visits; 30-40 minutes for Procedures. UHC Referral Mandate: Online referral is mandatory for United Healthcare patients before scheduling. Procedure Days Booking: Only book 1:40 PM and 2:30 PM slots (first post-lunch slot is 1:40 PM, NOT 1:30 PM). Strict 10-minute grace period for late arrivals. Route all Telephone Encounters (TEs) directly to Dr. Murphy.

Specialty: Cardiology at Forest Rd (2nd Floor), every Wednesday and occasional Sundays. Duration: 15 minutes for patients under 65; 30 minutes for patients aged 65+. Insurance Mandate: Does NOT accept MVP insurance; patient must be informed of the $100 self-pay fee at the time of booking. No referral is required for internal cardiology booking.

Specialty: Pain Management at Forest Rd (2nd Floor), every Tuesday. Duration: 30 minutes for initial Evaluation; 15-30 minutes for Follow-up. Referral is mandatory for all patients. Outside referrals require office notes, referral, and relevant imaging in the chart prior to booking. Route all Telephone Encounters (TEs) directly to Dr. Rosenberg.

Specialty: Sleep Medicine at Forest Rd (2nd Floor), every Tuesday. Duration: 30 minutes for initial Evaluation; 15 minutes for Follow-up. Referral is mandatory for all initial evaluations. Mandatory Patient Reminder: All sleep follow-up patients must be instructed to bring their CPAP machine to the visit.

rules.patient_reminder: Bring CPAP machine to follow-up visits

content: Specialty: Nutritionist at Forest Rd (2nd Floor), by appointment. Duration: 30-60 minutes for Initial Consult; 30 minutes for Follow-up. Referral is mandatory for all patients. Chaperone Policy: A female companion must accompany all male patients or male minors under 18. Contact Esther directly via Microsoft Teams for scheduling or tele-visits (TEs are rarely sent).

Pre-Bookable: Yes. Purpose: Comprehensive preventative health check-up. Duration: 30 minutes for all patients over 27 years old, or any patient seeing Dr. Shinder regardless of age; 15 minutes acceptable only for patients 26 and younger NOT seeing Dr. Shinder. ECW Documentation: For Medicare patients, set appointment reason strictly to 'Medicare PE' to trigger appropriate clinical/nursing protocols.

rules.short_duration_condition: Age 26 or under and not seeing Dr. Shinder

content: Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: Follows standard PE duration rules (scheduled until 8:00 PM on certain weekdays). Providers: Offered by Adam Tilson, Naftali Minzer, and Myer Gurkov. Age Limit: Available strictly for patients 40 years old and younger only. No CDL exams are permitted during evening hours.

Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: Must always be a 30-minute appointment. Definition: A patient who has NOT been seen by any provider in the Adult Medicine department within the past 3 years. Restriction: Adam Tilson does NOT see new patients over 60-65 years old (includes patients established with the clinic but new to him).
Pre-Bookable: NO (Same-Day Only; cannot be pre-booked in advance). Duration: 15 minutes. Purpose: For acute symptoms. Eligible patient age range: 18-65.

Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 15 minutes standard (30 minutes mandatory for patients aged 65+, chronic patients, or long problem lists). Purpose: For non-acute follow-ups, minor complaints, or in-person referral requests.

Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: Always a 30-minute appointment. Purpose: To follow up on care received in a hospital emergency room. Prerequisite: Hospital records are mandatory prior to booking. Send a Telephone Encounter (TE) to the PSS Queue with hospital details to obtain records before scheduling.

rules.prerequisite: Obtain hospital records via PSS Queue TE first

content: Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 30 minutes. Advise booking 30 days prior to surgery and advise that lab results take 5-7 days. Verify that the patient's Annual Physical (PE) is up to date and document 'Physical UTD' in the appointment reason.

Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 30 minutes. Provider: Naftali Minzer, PA only (maximum 2 per day: 1 morning, 1 afternoon). If Annual PE is up to date (<1 year), book a 30-minute Office Visit (OV); if PE is overdue, book an Annual PE and note 'CDL' in the reason. Former Dr. Derman patients pay a $100 self-pay fee.
Pre-Bookable: Yes. Duration: 15 minutes. Adult & Internal Medicine routinely performs suture removal. Advise callers not to delay removal and book promptly.
Pre-Bookable: Only with Provider Approval. Duration: Per provider schedule rules. Requires explicit provider authorization before booking; do not schedule a Tele-Visit without confirmation.

Slot Duration: 20 minutes. Location Mandate: Book exclusively at Forest Rd (Bakertown lab is not fully staffed). Prerequisites: Must have active lab orders from an internal provider on chart (includes Behavioral Health orders). If no order exists, book a PCP Office Visit first. Set the ordering provider as the appointment provider so results route back properly.
Slot Duration: Nurse Visit. Prerequisite: Medication ordered by a clinic provider. Used for self-injection education or weekly administration. Patient must bring their own medication to the clinic.

Slot Duration: 15 minutes on Nurse schedule. Prerequisite: Annual PE must be up to date. Critical Time Window: Follow-up 'Read' appointment must be booked strictly between 48 and 72 hours after the initial 'Plant'.

entity: COVID-19 Testing, Flu & Routine Injections (B12, Shingrix)
content: COVID-19 Testing: Asymptomatic (travel/pre-op) requires a 15-min Nurse visit for PCR (results in 48-72 hrs). Symptomatic patients must be evaluated by a provider via a standard Office Visit (NOT a nurse visit). Flu & Routine Injections (B12, Shingrix): 5-15 minutes on Nurse schedule with order on file. Flu shots run Mon-Thu 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM with Adam Tilson, PA listed as appointment provider. Routine 5-min injection slots can be double-booked.

Referral Specialist: Anisa Azeez handles general Adult Medicine referral routing. Online Insurance Referrals (e.g., UHC): 1) Confirm specialty requested. 2) Check eCW Outgoing Referrals. 3) If referral exists in chart, create TE to Adult Med PSS Queue with Specialist Full Name, Appointment Address, and Appointment Date. 4) If NO referral exists: If PE is UTD & seen recently, send TE to nurse with note 'If added in eCW, please forward TE to Jubilee for online submission'; if PE is UTD but not seen in a few months, book an Office Visit (OV); if PE is overdue, book Annual PE first. Urgent Requests: Contact Jubilee Aviles (Primary) or Viviana Molano (Secondary).

Handled Request Types: Medication refill requests (Annual PE must be up to date), clinical questions & triage, requests to speak with a provider, internal clinical review for referral requests, and lab results inquiries (Black Lock). Priority Guidelines: High Priority if patient is completely out of medication (use subject line 'RX refill - all out'); Standard Priority if 2-3 days of medication remain. Always include exact drug name, dosage, prescribing doctor, and pharmacy info.

CRITICAL ROUTING RULE: Medication Prior Authorizations and 2020 Transportation Forms must be sent to the PSS Queue, NOT the Nursing Queue. Handled Request Types: Medication Prior Authorizations (handled by PSS team / Viviana), Medicaid Transportation (2020 Forms), requests to mail/email labs, records, or forms, online insurance referrals (UHC submission), and ER records requests before booking ER follow-ups. Include patient contact, destination specialist info, appointment dates, or required documentation details.

entity: Former Patients of Dr. Derman Medication Refills
content: 1) Establish Care Required: Former patients of Dr. Derman must schedule an appointment with a new Aizer PCP. 2) Bridge Refills (Non-Controlled): If scheduled with an Aizer provider, request a bridge refill to cover medication until the appointment date. 3) Controlled Substances: Strictly require an in-person visit; no bridge refills permitted. 4) TE Workflow: Once visit is booked, route TE to Emely Espinosa, who queues the exact days required and routes to provider for sign-off.

2020 Form requests for Medicaid transportation are managed by Viviana Molano via the AMED_PSS Queue. Prerequisites: Verify patient has an active Annual PE and an existing referral on file for the destination specialist. Collect specialist full name, specialty, address, and appointment date before submitting.

NPP (New Patient Packet): Signed once upon clinic entry. HIPAA Privacy Consent: Signed annually. AM MRC (Adult Medicine Medical Release Consent): Signed annually to authorize record retrieval. ECW Documentation: In Appointment General Notes, list any missing forms due; if all forms are current, type 'AF COMP [Your Initials]'.
